JOIN songs ON songs_artists.song_id = songs.id
WHERE songs.genre = 'country'
GROUP BY artists.id, artists.name
ORDER BY song_count DESC
LIMIT 2;
SELECT state, SUM(num_wells) AS num_wells FROM state_wells GROUP BY state;
SELECT MAX(pollution_level) FROM pollution_monitoring_atlantic;
SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM europium_production WHERE region = 'Oceania';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM smart_contract_deployments WHERE developer_name = 'Hayden Adams';
SELECT COUNT(*) AS mine_count, SUM(capacity) AS total_capacity FROM terbium_mines WHERE country = 'China';
SELECT DISTINCT make, model FROM japan_ev_sales WHERE year >= 2019;

SELECT cd.initiative_name
FROM community_development cd
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM rural_innovations ri
  WHERE ri.initiation_year = cd.initiation_year
);
SELECT name FROM urban_agriculture_initiatives WHERE location = 'Montreal' AND area_ha > 0.5;
SELECT SUM(violation_count) FROM regulatory_violations WHERE platform IN ('Coinbase', 'Huobi');

SELECT species, SUM(carbon) AS total_carbon
FROM forests_carbon_seq
WHERE type = 'tropical dry forests'
GROUP BY species
ORDER BY total_carbon DESC
LIMIT 3;
SELECT name, production_date FROM machines WHERE category = 'circular_economy' AND production_date > '2015-12-31';
SELECT SUM(esg_score) FROM company_scores WHERE company = 'Green Horizons' AND year = 2021 AND quarter IN (3, 4);
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT business_id) FROM sustainable_tourism WHERE year = 2021 AND benefited = 1;
SELECT SUM(retreats) FROM GlacierRetreats WHERE location = 'Norway' AND year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2020;
SELECT AVG(Playtime) FROM Player_Details WHERE Game_Name = 'Cybernetic Shift';
SELECT job_category, AVG(weekly_wage) FROM labor_stats GROUP BY job_category;
SELECT SUM(amount) FROM communication_investments WHERE region IN ('Africa', 'Oceania') AND year BETWEEN 2010 AND 2020;
SELECT v.* FROM vessels v WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cargo c WHERE c.vessel_id = v.id AND c.weight > ?);

SELECT team_id, SUM(total_sales) AS total_home_sales
FROM team_performance
WHERE home_game = 1 AND total_sales > 0
GROUP BY team_id;

SELECT v.id, v.name
FROM Visitor v
JOIN Visitor_Exhibition ve ON v.id = ve.visitor_id
GROUP BY v.id, v.name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ve.exhibition_id) > 1;
SELECT MAX(Value) FROM Investments WHERE Market = 'US Stock Market';
SELECT SUM(sessions) AS total_sessions FROM financial_capability_training WHERE country = 'Germany' AND quarter = 1 AND year = 2022;
SELECT AVG(energy_output) FROM renewable_energy WHERE energy_type = 'wind';
SELECT MAX(revenue) FROM sustainable_tours WHERE country = 'Japan';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM deep_sea_expeditions WHERE location LIKE '%Pacific%';
SELECT SUM(cost) FROM SpacecraftManuf WHERE year = 2023 AND company IN ('Cosmic Corp.', 'Starlight Inc.');
SELECT AVG(rate) FROM recycling_rates;
SELECT SUM(generation_quantity) FROM waste_generation WHERE city = 'Rio de Janeiro' AND waste_type = 'Metal' AND strftime('%Y', generation_date) = '2021';
SELECT MAX(usage) AS max_daily_water_usage FROM max_daily_water_usage WHERE year = 2021 AND month = 10 AND LOWER(sector) = 'industrial';

SELECT SUM(p.price * s.quantity) AS total_revenue
FROM product p
JOIN sales s ON p.product_id = s.product_id
WHERE p.cruelty_free = 0;

SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS total_events
FROM defense_diplomacy_4
GROUP BY country
ORDER BY total_events DESC;
SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM Global_Sales WHERE year = 2021 AND LOWER(vehicle_type) IN ('electric', 'hybrid');

SELECT DISTINCT e.FirstName, e.LastName
FROM Employees e
JOIN Projects p ON e.Department = p.Department
WHERE p.ProjectName = 'Wind Turbines'
  AND e.Position LIKE '%Engineer%';

SELECT MIN(CAST(mu.co2_emissions AS REAL) / mu.quantity) AS min_co2_per_unit
FROM brands b
JOIN material_usage mu ON b.brand_id = mu.brand_id
WHERE b.country = 'Spain'
  AND mu.material_type = 'sustainable'
  AND mu.quantity > 0;
SELECT MIN(max_speed), MAX(max_speed) FROM spacecraft WHERE launch_company = 'SpaceX';
SELECT AVG(recycling_rate) FROM recycling_rates WHERE state = 'California' AND year = 2020;
SELECT SUM(population) FROM wildlife WHERE year = 2020;
SELECT MAX(price), MIN(size_sqft) FROM property WHERE has_inclusive_policy = TRUE;
SELECT AVG(ph) FROM saltwater_aquaculture WHERE location = 'North Atlantic';

SELECT AVG(price / quantity) AS avg_price_per_gram
FROM dispensary
WHERE name = 'Dispensary X'
  AND product LIKE '%concentrate%'
  AND quantity > 0;
SELECT MIN(shipments.shipment_weight) FROM shipments JOIN ports ON shipments.port_id = ports.port_id WHERE ports.port_name = 'Port of Tokyo' AND strftime('%Y', shipments.ship_date) = '2018';

SELECT program, energy_savings,
       AVG(energy_savings) OVER (
           PARTITION BY program
           ORDER BY rowid
           ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
       ) AS moving_avg
FROM energy_efficiency;
SELECT market_share FROM market_share_2 WHERE hotel_chain = 'Hotel Chain C' AND region = 'South America';

SELECT SUM(Donations.amount)
FROM Donations
JOIN Donors ON Donations.donor_id = Donors.donor_id
WHERE Donors.country = 'Brazil'
  AND Donations.cause = 'climate change mitigation';

SELECT MIN(TotalHoursPlayed) AS MinPlaytime, MAX(TotalHoursPlayed) AS MaxPlaytime
FROM Players, GameDesign
WHERE GameDesign.Multiplayer = 1
ORDER BY COUNT(Players.PlayerID) DESC;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_funding
FROM Funding
WHERE LOWER(program) LIKE '%cultural%'
  AND (
    LOWER(program) LIKE '%women%'
    OR LOWER(program) LIKE '%non-binary%'
    OR LOWER(program) LIKE '%nonbinary%'
  );

SELECT c.name AS country, COALESCE(SUM(f.hectares), 0) AS total_hectares
FROM Countries c
LEFT JOIN Forests f ON f.country = c.name
GROUP BY c.name;

SELECT ArtistName, SUM(SalesAmount) AS TotalRevenue
FROM MusicSales
GROUP BY ArtistName
ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC
LIMIT 3;
SELECT AVG(rating) FROM hotels WHERE country = 'United States' AND ai_services = 1;
SELECT MAX(property_price) FROM sustainable_communities;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accidents a JOIN vessels v ON a.vessel_id = v.id WHERE v.cargo_capacity > 5000;
SELECT name, budget FROM programs WHERE participants > 50;
SELECT Country, AVG(Consumption) AS AvgConsumption FROM EnergyConsumptionPerCapita WHERE Year = 2021 GROUP BY Country;

SELECT program_id
FROM programs
WHERE program_year = 2019
GROUP BY program_id
ORDER BY SUM(impact_score) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT service, COUNT(*) AS total_complaints FROM customer_complaints GROUP BY service;
SELECT AVG(total_spending) FROM gaming_facts WHERE country IN ('USA', 'Canada', 'Mexico');

SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS total_properties
FROM properties
WHERE inclusive_policy = 1
GROUP BY city;

SELECT p.name, s.name
FROM products p
JOIN suppliers s ON p.supplier_id = s.id
WHERE s.name <> 'Green Cotton Inc.';

SELECT country, SUM(calories) AS total_calories
FROM workouts
GROUP BY country
ORDER BY total_calories DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT s.name, AVG(l.progress) AS average_progress
FROM schools s
JOIN lifelong_learning l ON s.school_id = l.school_id
GROUP BY s.school_id, s.name;

SELECT DISTINCT s.supplier_name
FROM suppliers s
JOIN ingredients i ON s.supplier_id = i.supplier_id
JOIN restaurants r ON i.restaurant_id = r.restaurant_id
WHERE r.rating = 'Organic';
SELECT Country, COUNT(*) AS player_count FROM Players GROUP BY Country ORDER BY player_count DESC LIMIT 3;

SELECT project_type, COUNT(*) AS project_count, SUM(budget) AS total_budget
FROM explainable_ai_projects
GROUP BY project_type
ORDER BY total_budget DESC;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Events WHERE num_attendees > (SELECT AVG(num_attendees) FROM Events);
SELECT id, country, amount FROM Contributors ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM game_designers WHERE country IN ('Algeria', 'Angola', 'Benin', 'Botswana', 'Burkina Faso', 'Burundi', 'Cabo Verde', 'Cameroon', 'Central African Republic', 'Chad', 'Comoros', 'Congo', 'Democratic Republic of the Congo', 'Djibouti', 'Egypt', 'Equatorial Guinea', 'Eritrea', 'Eswatini', 'Ethiopia', 'Gabon', 'Gambia', 'Ghana', 'Guinea', 'Guinea-Bissau', 'Ivory
SELECT project_name, cost FROM creative_ai_projects ORDER BY cost DESC LIMIT 3;
SELECT state, SUM(length) AS total_length FROM Highways GROUP BY state;

SELECT p.gender, SUM(c.claim_amount) AS total_claim_amount
FROM claims c
JOIN policyholders p ON c.policyholder_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.gender;
